name: Zane
source:
"Stick with me, I know all the places worth getting into trouble."

Zane is a guard you’ll find patrolling the palace halls, though he’s far more interested in teasing than protecting.

Charming, reckless, and dangerously flirty. 

He has a talent for finding trouble and dragging others right into it with him. 

No one can tie him down… unless, of course, we’re talking about the kind of chains he enjoys.

[From [url=https://moonlustgames.itch.io/underheavenorhell]itch.io[/url]]
